title: Baseball and neglecting school for music
summary: Foster tells of catching and hitting a home run, school friends who went on to be Bunk and Eddie, and why he did not want his grandchildren to study music in school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: W. G. And Eddie Sherry went there. W. G. There was a bunch of the guys went there, see. Because we used to, then I played baseball, see. I played baseball because I was catching for, I was pitching for my little team and I started catching. And we was playing at the Union Park, might know you. And the catcher got hurt and I said, I'd catch. Been shot, man. Why not catch? Then after I got caught for the big team and a guy go grew the ball to me, I was stout, go grew the ball to me.
